summary: PennantPark Investment Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Note Purchase Agreement for a private placement of senior unsecured notes: $62M of 8.00% notes due 2031 and $2M of 7.25% notes due 2029. The notes pay semi-annual interest, are redeemable at make-whole or fixed premiums, include change-of-control prepayment offers, and carry standard covenants and events of default. This is routine debt financing, not a special situation; no special-situation category applies.
